contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP.CAESAR VESPASIANVS AVG ; R/ COS/VI(?I)

Silver Coin – Denarius of Vespasian (69-79). Issue of 75-76. Obverse description: Vespasian laureate right. Obverse inscription: IMP.CAESAR VESPASIANVS AVG. Reverse description: Eagle standing on garlanded base, head left. Reverse inscription: COS/VI(?I) Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin If Cos VI, this would be RIC 89; issue of AD 75; otherwise RIC 99, issue of AD 76. Diameter: 17.67mm, Weight: 2.90gms, die axis: 6
